title: Satya Nadella says companies must build both human capital and token capital, with human judgment guiding AI systems that learn and improve over time (Satya Nadella/@satyanadella)
summary: Satya Nadella / @satyanadella: Satya Nadella says companies must build both human capital and token capital, with human judgment guiding AI systems that learn and improve over time — https://x.com/...
contentText:
Satya Nadella / @satyanadella :

Satya Nadella says companies must own their AI “learning loops” to compound human and token capital, or risk ceding all value to a handful of frontier models   —  I've been thinking a lot about the future of the firm in an AI-driven economy.  This transition is different than any previous platform shift.
